newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks poised to bounce higher if PPI pleases.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks poised to bounce higher if PPI pleases.

text.p: Wall Street stocks will look to two key September reports on producer prices and retail sales Friday morning for their direction on the day.
After a week-long selloff in stocks and in bonds, analysts said markets could get a lift on Friday, provided that the data do not set off inflation alarms on Wall Street.

"Everything hinges on those two numbers," said Hildegard Zagorski, market analyst at Prudential Securities. "If they're too strong, that's going to hurt, but otherwise I think we could go higher today."
